<script type="text/javascript">
$(document).ready(function(){
	$("ul#slmenu").lavaLamp({fx: "backout", speed: 700});
	$("#SearchInput").focus(function() {
		if($("#SearchInput").val() == "Tournaments quick search") {
			$("#SearchInput").val("");
		}
	});
	$("#SearchInput").blur(function() {
		if($("#SearchInput").val() == "") {
			$("#SearchInput").val("Tournaments quick search");
		}
		$("#SearchResults").slideUp();
	});
	$("#SearchInput").keyup(function(e) {
		$("#SearchResults").load("/quicksearch/tournaments/", { SearchInput: $("#SearchInput").val() }).slideDown();
		$("#SearchResults").on("mousedown mouseup", "li a", function(e){
			e.stopPropagation();
			e.preventDefault();
		});
	});
});
</script>
